en.headline: Science Park carnival opens activity sign-up this morning
en.dek: The Innovation and Technology Commission says free workshop and talk places for the late-October carnival can be booked from 10:30am.
body: The Innovation and Technology Commission's InnoCarnival 2026 opens online registration for some activities at 10:30am on Tuesday, the organisers said. The nine-day carnival itself runs from 24 October to 1 November at Hong Kong Science Park.

Exhibition booths do not need a ticket or advance booking, the organisers said. More than 40 local universities, government departments, research centres, public bodies, non-governmental organisations and education groups are due to set up stands. Admission is free.

Some on-site activities and about 15 online talks do require a place. Registration for those opens from 10:30am on Tuesday, and accounts can already be activated. Weekend opening hours on 24 and 25 October, 31 October and 1 November are 10am to 6pm; weekday hours from 26 to 30 October are 10am to 5pm. The organisers said there will be no guided tours.

zh.headline: 創新科技嘉年華今早開放部分活動報名
zh.dek: 創新科技署主辦的科學園嘉年華於10月24日起舉行，工作坊及網上講座今早10時半起可網上報名，入場免費。
body: 創新科技署主辦的「創新科技嘉年華2026」周二上午10時半起接受部分活動網上報名。嘉年華本身於10月24日至11月1日在香港科學園舉行，為期九日。
主辦方表示，實體展覽攤位毋須門票，亦毋須預先報名。屆時會有超過40間本地大學、政府部門、研發中心、公營機構、非政府組織及教育團體設置攤位，入場免費。
部分實體活動及約15場網上講座則須報名，周二上午10時半起可登記，帳戶現已可預先啟動。主辦方稱，10月24日、25日、31日及11月1日的周末開放時間為上午10時至下午6時；10月26日至30日平日為上午10時至下午5時。大會不會安排導賞團。
